name: JALI 22 Viseme
description: Connect the JALI lip-sync attributes by the same name, Source -> Destination. 22 VisemeNet-style names: Jaw and Lip (the JA-LI control axes) plus the 20 visemes (Ah Aa Eh Ee Ih Oh Uh U Eu Schwa R S ShChZh Th JY LNTD GK MBP FV W). Plus the 16 angela / A0020_jali_slider_ctl DUMMY_OUT_PHONEMES names (AAA Eh AHH OHH UUU IEE RRR WWW SSS FFF TTH MBP SSH Schwa GK LNTD) so a DUMMY_OUT_PHONEMES node connects too. Objects are paired row by row (Source[i] -> Destination[i]); an attribute missing on either side is skipped.
